newsitem.title: USA: Pa. lawmaker proposes referendum on sales tax hike.
newsitem.headline: Pa. lawmaker proposes referendum on sales tax hike.

text.p: Pennsylvania state Rep. Terry Van Horne has proposed a November referendum seeking voters' support for a increase in the sales tax.
The Westmoreland County Democrat wants a 1/2 percent increase in the sales tax to help fund a new baseball-only stadium in Pittsburgh, along with other regional projects.

If the bill passes, 10 counties in western Pennsylvania would see the question on the November ballot. Van Horne said the money would be used to fund projects in the counties that vote to participate.
